airport_records.name: Barbuda – Codrington (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Old Codrington site, not modern Burton-Nibbs. AIP Supplement20/24 explicitly closes TAPH on2October2024 and opens TAPB on3October2024. IATA BBQ has transferred; use the closed TAPH coordinate record, not AG-0001. Coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not surveyed1986 terminal or runway positions. Later expansions are not reconstructed.

airport_records.name: Montserrat – Trants (1986)
airport_records.location_note: Old Blackburne/W.H.Bramble airport at Trants, historical ICAO TRPM. Montserrat government heritage booklet printedpage23 describes its replacement by the new airport at Geralds in2005. Do not use current TRPG/MNI coordinates. Neutral geographic name avoids assuming the date of the Bramble renaming. Coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not surveyed1986 terminal or runway positions. Later expansions are not reconstructed.
